headline: Sensex and Nifty face volatility amid US Fed rate decision and Jio Platforms' strong market debut

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: US Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady despite inflation concerns
Rising crude oil prices near $115 per barrel weighing on market sentiment
Significant selling pressure in the IT and Oil & Gas sectors
Global market caution ahead of and following the FOMC meeting outcomes
whatHappening: Jio Platforms shares soared during their market debut, impacting market capitalization rankings
PNB Housing Finance reported a 6% increase in Q2 net profit to ₹617 crore
The US Fed announced plans to reduce the frequency of rate-setting meetings starting in 2027
Indian indices experienced a sharp decline with the Sensex plunging nearly 1,000 points in a recent session
summary: Indian markets are experiencing volatility as investors react to the US Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady and rising crude oil prices. While the IT and Oil & Gas sectors have faced selling pressure, Jio Platforms made a strong market debut and PNB Housing Finance reported positive quarterly growth. The market remains cautious amid global macroeconomic shifts and domestic earnings reports.
